title: Bhumij Revolt
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Bhumij Revolt", at revision 1382605957, opens: "The Bhumij Revolt was revolt of Bhumij tribals, led by Ganga Narayan Singh during 1832–33 in the Manbhum and Jungle Mahal areas of the erstwhile Midnapore district, Bengal." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q12444297, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1832-33 Indian tribal rebellion". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
